tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List brands visible to this API token.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Retrieve a single brand by hash.

tools.name: list_brand_audiences
tools.description: List audiences with fit scores for a brand. High-fit only unless include_low_fit=true.

tools.name: list_audiences
tools.description: List project audiences visible to this API token.

tools.name: get_audience
tools.description: Retrieve a single audience by hash.

tools.name: get_audience_patterns
tools.description: Get pattern analysis for an audience. pattern_type is required (one of: type, format, structure, categories, main_topic, content_angle, tone, audience, language, hook_type, hook_phrase, hook_visual, cta_type, cta_style). Optional upload_timeframe, more_than_one_video, show_other_options, sort.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: List ideas for a brand. Requires brand_hash.

tools.name: get_idea
tools.description: Retrieve a single idea by hash.

tools.name: generate_idea
tools.description: Generate one idea for a brand. Optional promotion_rating 0-10.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: List scripts. Requires brand_hash and/or idea_hash.

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: Retrieve a single script by hash.

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: Generate a script from idea_hash, or from brand_hash (creates one idea first). Optional promotion_rating 0-10.
